channel.title: claude.dev Blog
channel.description: Articles, videos, and build logs from Anthropic’s developers on building with Claude and Claude Code, including tips, tricks, and points of view.

item.title: How the Claude Code team does code review
item.description: How do you review code at the volume agents produce it? On the Claude Code team, once we had high coverage and deep reviews, we started optimizing for the minimum amount of human review time that doesn't raise reverts or incidents.
item.dc:creator: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, and Qing Wang

item.title: Building effective agent automations
item.description: A reference implementation walkthrough with common failure modes
item.dc:creator: Lance Martin and CJ Avilla

item.title: Claude Code in the cloud: a field guide to cloud sessions
item.description: Cloud sessions run Claude Code on a fresh VM for each task. Four real sessions, seven workflows that suit them, and how to connect GitHub without getting stuck.
item.dc:creator: Addy Osmani

item.title: Getting started with Claude Code mods
item.description: Mods are hooks that ship inside plugins and run inside your Claude Code session. Build one from an empty folder, then tour two larger mods.
item.dc:creator: Addy Osmani

item.title: Building with Claude Sonnet 5.5
item.description: When to choose Sonnet over Opus, what it costs, and how to tune it.
item.dc:creator: Addy Osmani

item.title: Automating eval design and hillclimbing with Claude
item.description: Principles for designing evals and hillclimbing against them without fooling yourself, and how the claude-api skill's build-eval and hillclimb commands put them to work.
item.dc:creator: Lance Martin

item.title: What a task costs on Opus 5.5
item.description: The same token price can cost very different amounts per task. Learn what Claude Code tasks cost on Opus 5.5 and which settings change the bill.
item.dc:creator: Addy Osmani

item.title: Using Claude Code: Spending your effort
item.description: What effort really is and when to use which level in Claude Code, from my own tests of three builds and a deep dive into Terminal-Bench 3.0 on Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1.

item.title: How we made claude.ai 3x faster in two weeks
item.description: Inside our performance sprint: the benchmarks Claude built, the loop each Slack thread ran, and the guardrails that let us ship 3,000 changes safely.
item.dc:creator: Raymond Wang, Sam Attard, and Issac G.

item.title: Getting the most out of Opus 5.5 in Claude and Claude Code
item.description: How to prompt Opus 5.5, steer a long run, and check your results in Claude apps and Claude Code.
item.dc:creator: Addy Osmani

item.title: The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
item.description: We removed over 80% of Claude Code's system prompt for more advanced models. How to apply the lessons we learned to your own context engineering in Claude Code and with your own agents.

item.title: Lessons from building Claude Code: How we use skills

item.title: A harness for every task: dynamic workflows in Claude Code

item.title: Using Claude Code: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML
